title: Prove the exact repair minimum for one centre block
body:
## Summary

- Close PR3656's full-kernel question on its exact 4,080-owner centre-repair block, allowing all 112 source ports.
- Prove that the common kernel is exactly one-dimensional. The sharp minimum is 424,319 extra scalar linear observations, attained by 103 coordinate reads per owner and 4,079 anchor differences.
- Under the declared one-rank-one-child-per-observation tariff, repair exceeds even complete centre deletion by 163,199 rank units, with all other costs granted free. This stops that specific repair architecture.

## Scope and limits

The result retains the selected calls-0/4 regular-owner, constant-payload, whole-later-query model and its inherited source/native adapter premises. Exact finite route and rational-rank certificates support a written all-coefficient proof over Q and C. Equal arbitrary dirt suffices for the lower bound; attaining the source-field interface does not implement native dirt cancellation or restoration.

Only this subgroup coset and its left translates are covered. Compressed higher-rank collectors, different blocks/readers and physical acquisition remain open. No minimum-support classification, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa is established. See the [proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ae335a2be3f904d54f3e12690c58ca59b81d50a/research/centre-coset-full-kernel/PROOF.md), [finite certificate](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ae335a2be3f904d54f3e12690c58ca59b81d50a/research/centre-coset-full-kernel/RESULT.json) and [validation scope](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ae335a2be3f904d54f3e12690c58ca59b81d50a/research/centre-coset-full-kernel/VALIDATION.md).

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-coset-full-kernel` — primary and separately implemented route/rank checks, explicit optimal read interface and defect controls.
- [x] `python3.14 -I -O -Werror -B research/centre-coset-full-kernel/verify.py`.
- [x] Exact committed 19-file export: replay both standalone commands outside Git and verify every exported input remains unchanged. The export orchestration is local-only; the mathematical commands and complete source closure are public.
- [x] [Hosted registered-package workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39167541919) completed successfully on the exact published head; source trees match.
- [ ] Independent human mathematical review remains open.

Tested commit: `1ae335a2be3f904d54f3e12690c58ca59b81d50a`. Separate AI derivations and implementations are described in [INDEPENDENT.md](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ae335a2be3f904d54f3e12690c58ca59b81d50a/research/centre-coset-full-kernel/INDEPENDENT.md); they are not independent human or formal-kernel review.
